title: cmux-perf-result/v1
description: One perf-lab result: the raw samples of one metric of one story run, with the build, host, engine, session, resolved features and attachments that produced it (plans/cmux-next/chrome-parity/p12-perf-process.md section 3.4). Results are stored one JSON object per line in .ndjson files; scripts/perf-lab/perf_result.py writes and reads them. Every key is required so a writer states 'unknown' as null instead of leaving it out. The series key is (story, metric, engine, host.class, macOS major, build.config); features_hash, host.macos_build and safe_mode are point metadata only. run names the run that measured the samples, so two runs with equal samples stay two results (catapult's BENCHMARK_START / LABEL diagnostics, tracing/tracing/value/diagnostics/reserved_infos.py).

run.description: The run that measured the samples. Every result of one run carries the same run; a retry of the same write (same id) is idempotent, a new run is a new result.

id.description: uuid4 hex by default, or the caller's stable attempt id (for example a controller job and attempt).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC start time of the run, for example 2026-10-25T12:00:00.123456Z.

story.description: Story id, the stem of scripts/perf-lab/stories.d/<id>.json.

metric.description: Metric row inside the story, for example cmd_w.light.key_to_frame. Existing report keys keep their names.

unit.description: Export to catapult's histogram units (third_party/catapult/tracing/tracing/value/histogram.py UNIT_NAMES), as unit -> catapult unit x factor: ms -> ms, us -> ms x 1e-3, ns -> ms x 1e-6, s -> ms x 1e3, count -> count, ratio -> unitless, percent -> n% x 1e-2, bytes -> sizeInBytes, bytes_per_s -> bytesPerSecond, mW -> W x 1e-3, J -> J, Hz -> Hz, fps -> Hz, per_s -> Hz, score -> unitless, unitless -> unitless (perf_result.CATAPULT_UNITS).

better.description: catapult's improvement_direction: lower -> smallerIsBetter, higher -> biggerIsBetter.

samples.description: Raw samples in run order, never pre-aggregated percentiles. Each fits a finite float64.

target_ref.description: The target this metric is judged against: a targets.json id, or a key in an existing threshold file (floors are referenced, never copied; spec R4). null when the metric has no target.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the existing threshold file.

config.description: Debug results are never compared with bench results: config is part of the series key.

measure_version.description: PERF_LAB_MEASURE_VERSION of the harness that measured the build. As in 2020-12, 1.0 is an integer; the reader turns it into 1.

fingerprint.description: host_env.py fingerprint: sha256 of chip, macOS build, Hz and memory.

class.description: Host class (chip + memory + display Hz); excludes the macOS build.

macos.description: macOS product version; null on a Linux host.

macos_build.description: macOS build, for example 25B78; null on a Linux host.

display_hz.description: Measured refresh rate of the display the story ran on; null for a headless story.

features.description: Resolved features of the measured build, with the source of each state. Empty when the build cannot list its features.

source.description: The resolution step that set the state (spec 3.9, highest first).

features_hash.description: The build's own features hash (the one hang reports carry); null when the build has no feature registry.

safe_mode.description: off: disabled by CMUX_FEATURES_SAFE_MODE=off; inactive: enabled, not triggered; last_known_good / no_remote: Chrome's safe seed and null seed levels. null when the build does not report it.
